d: For some dogs, the hardest part of life begins long before they reach a rescue centre. At Villalobos Rescue Center, Tia Torres takes on the stories of abandoned, injured and sick dogs who need someone to stand by them. Through a series of pit bull rescue missions, the team works to bring vulnerable strays to safety, provide care and introduce them to people willing to open their homes. Each dog has a different past, and every adoption brings its own hopes and uncertainties.
